items.title: PayPal (PYPL) Brings Tuition Payments To U.S. Campuses Through New Integrations
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) and Venmo can now be used for U.S. university tuition payments through new integrations with Illumia, Nelnet, and TouchNet. The expansion brings PayPal and Venmo into higher value, recurring tuition and fee payments for students and families. The move increases PayPal’s presence on college campuses and supports tuition transactions with its existing security protections.
